testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.jobs.InAppPaymentKeepAliveJobTest

testcase.name: Given an unregistered local user, when I run, then I expect skip
Given a past-due subscription with charge failure, when I run, then I do not write cancellation
Given a canceled subscription, when I run, then I write cancellation and return early
